nodes.name: dashboard.py
nodes.summary: Assembles Overview and Comparisons page data by joining stored comparisons with their runs and tickets, keeping fake-provider runs out of the metrics.

nodes.name: load_rows
nodes.summary: Joins comparison records with their two runs and ticket in the given order, labelling deleted tickets.

nodes.name: is_fake
nodes.summary: Detects rows where either side used a mock- model.

nodes.name: model_of
nodes.summary: Returns an execution's actual model, falling back to the requested model.

nodes.name: summary
nodes.summary: Builds the Overview payload of ticket counts, real and excluded comparison counts, models and metrics over real runs only.

nodes.name: list_item
nodes.summary: Flattens a joined row into one Comparisons list entry with models, timings and the fake flag.

nodes.name: list_comparisons
nodes.summary: Returns joined list items for the requested comparisons plus their total count.

nodes.name: detail
nodes.summary: Returns one comparison joined with its ticket and runs, or None.

nodes.name: run_metrics.py
nodes.summary: Computes pure metrics for a set of Jev-vs-LLM comparisons: per-field agreement and Cohen's kappa, latency, tokens, outcomes, cost, Jev confidence, distributions and disagreements.

nodes.name: percentile
nodes.summary: Computes a nearest-rank percentile, returning None for an empty list.

nodes.name: kappa
nodes.summary: Computes Cohen's kappa for label pairs, returning None when there are no pairs or no variety.

nodes.name: latency
nodes.summary: Summarizes run durations as count, mean, median, 90th percentile, minimum and maximum.

nodes.name: tokens
nodes.summary: Totals and averages provider-reported tokens and output tokens per second, never estimating unreported usage.

nodes.name: outcomes
nodes.summary: Counts runs by status and computes the success rate.

nodes.name: cost
nodes.summary: Totals the estimated cost of priced runs, returning None when no run has a price.

nodes.name: jev_confidence
nodes.summary: Averages Jev's confidence per field, overall and split by whether the LLM agreed.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Produces the full run metrics, using completed comparisons for agreement and every recorded run for latency, tokens, outcomes and cost.

nodes.name: run_report.py
nodes.summary: Renders one test run as a self-contained HTML report with inline CSS, SVG charts and summary tables, escaping stored text and stating that agreement is not accuracy.

nodes.name: fmt
nodes.summary: Formats a number with digits and a suffix, or a dash when missing.

nodes.name: pct
nodes.summary: Formats a ratio as a whole percentage, or a dash when missing.

nodes.name: secs
nodes.summary: Formats milliseconds as seconds, or a dash when missing.

nodes.name: table
nodes.summary: Renders headers and rows as a horizontally scrollable HTML table with right-aligned numeric columns.

nodes.name: agreement_chart
nodes.summary: Draws an inline SVG of horizontal agreement bars, one per field, on a single 0-100% scale.

nodes.name: speed_chart
nodes.summary: Draws an inline SVG dumbbell chart of Jev and LLM seconds per ticket on one shared scale.

nodes.name: word
nodes.summary: Returns escaped display text for a field value, showing escalation booleans as words.

nodes.name: mark
nodes.summary: Returns the HTML marker for agree, differ or not compared.

nodes.name: ticket_rows
nodes.summary: Builds one table row per ticket with both sides' answers, agreement marks and timings.

nodes.name: side
nodes.summary: Returns the opening HTML of a legend key with the Jev or LLM color swatch.

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Assembles the complete report from run metadata, metrics and rows, covering agreement, speed, reliability, usage, confidence, distributions and disagreements.

nodes.name: run_report.py
nodes.summary: Command-line entry point that loads named comparisons from MongoDB and writes a test run's HTML report and JSON record to reports/test-runs.

nodes.name: load_run
nodes.summary: Loads the named comparisons in the given order and exits with an error when any are missing.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Parses arguments, loads the run, closes the database client and writes the HTML report and JSON record.

nodes.name: test_csv.py
nodes.summary: API-level tests for CSV import and export, covering row counts, normalization, duplicates, dry runs, label separation, malformed files, formula neutralization and payload exclusion.

nodes.name: api
nodes.summary: Pytest fixture providing a TestClient for an app built with test settings and the test database.

nodes.name: upload
nodes.summary: Test helper that posts CSV text or bytes to the import route.

nodes.name: csv_of
nodes.summary: Test helper that joins the import header with the given rows into CSV text.

nodes.name: errors_by_row
nodes.summary: Test helper that groups an import summary's error fields by row number.

nodes.name: test_template_matches_the_spec_file
nodes.summary: Checks the downloaded template is a CSV attachment whose header matches the specification's template file.

nodes.name: test_mixed_file_reports_accurate_counts
nodes.summary: Checks a mixed file reports exact imported, invalid and duplicate counts and the fields in error for each row.

nodes.name: test_valid_rows_are_stored_with_import_source_and_normalised_values
nodes.summary: Checks imported rows keep their import source and fingerprint, normalize the channel and set the sample flag from the label.

nodes.name: test_labels_are_stored_separately_from_tickets
nodes.summary: Checks expected labels go only to evaluation_labels and do not appear on the ticket document.

nodes.name: test_reimporting_the_same_file_skips_every_row
nodes.summary: Checks re-importing a file adds no tickets and reports its valid rows as duplicates.

nodes.name: test_dry_run_reports_without_writing
nodes.summary: Checks a dry run reports counts and a preview while leaving tickets and counters untouched.

nodes.name: test_import_never_runs_ai
nodes.summary: Checks an import creates no AI executions or comparisons.

nodes.name: test_bom_crlf_and_quoted_multiline_description
nodes.summary: Checks a byte-order mark and CRLF line endings are handled and a quoted multi-line description stays exact.

nodes.name: test_unreadable_files_are_rejected_whole
nodes.summary: Checks empty, column-deficient, header-only and non-UTF-8 files are each rejected with a 400.

nodes.name: test_oversized_file_is_rejected
nodes.summary: Checks a body over 5 MB is rejected with a 413.

nodes.name: test_supplied_100_ticket_sample_is_valid
nodes.summary: Checks the supplied 100-ticket sample passes a dry run with no invalid rows.

nodes.name: read_csv
nodes.summary: Test helper that asserts a successful CSV response and parses it into dictionaries.

nodes.name: test_ticket_export_is_valid_csv_and_neutralises_formulas
nodes.summary: Checks the ticket export parses as CSV and prefixes formula-like cells with a quote.

nodes.name: test_execution_export_leaves_out_payloads
nodes.summary: Checks the execution export includes usage and result columns but no stored payload text.

nodes.name: test_comparison_export_has_per_field_columns
nodes.summary: Checks the comparison export flattens field comparisons into Jev, GPT and match columns.

nodes.name: test_unknown_export_is_404
nodes.summary: Checks an unknown export name is rejected with a 404 or 422.

nodes.name: test_run_metrics.py
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the run metrics, using hand-built rows to check percentile, kappa, completed-only agreement, latency, tokens, outcomes, cost and Jev confidence.

nodes.name: execution
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds an execution dict with a duration, result, status and optional reported tokens.

nodes.name: result
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a normalized result with configurable category, priority, confidence and summary.

nodes.name: comparison
nodes.summary: Test helper that builds a Completed comparison when both results exist and a Partial one otherwise.

nodes.name: row
nodes.summary: Test helper that combines a ticket, both executions and their comparison into one metrics row.

nodes.name: test_percentile_and_kappa
nodes.summary: Checks nearest-rank percentile and kappa, including the undefined and perfectly opposed cases.

nodes.name: test_agreement_metrics_use_completed_comparisons_only
nodes.summary: Checks agreement figures and disagreements ignore a partial comparison.

nodes.name: test_latency_tokens_and_outcomes
nodes.summary: Checks latency, wall-clock, token, outcome and cost metrics against hand-worked values.

nodes.name: test_jev_confidence_split_by_agreement
nodes.summary: Checks Jev's confidence is averaged separately for agreeing and differing rows.
